breakdown.description: Lumped-capacitance method is requested even though Bi=5 violates the small-Biot validity condition.
breakdown.reason: The agent correctly identified that a Biot number of 5 is invalid for the lumped-capacitance method. It resolved this inconsistency by changing the Biot number to 0.05, which is a valid value for this method (Bi < 0.1). This correction aligns perfectly with the approach taken in the ground truth prompt.
